_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.

items.text: Try the new KPI card controls on the Dashboard: hover a headline card → × hides it (restore from the 'Hidden (N)' button), the big number sits centered in the title row, and cards open collapsed (only the top half) — click a card to expand, or 'Expand all / Collapse all' at the top right of the grid. It's per-browser (no sign-in). Tell me if you want a different default (e.g. open expanded).

Check the Activity Metrics cards: the big number for the 5 KPI-mapped sub-activities (3.1 students, 3.2 transcribed units, 2.1 credit recs, 3.3 colleges) now matches the headline KPI cards exactly (3.1 should read ~48,158, not the old 43,630), and the Goal/Stretch bars recompute from it. Others mirror the Annual Workplan 'Current' if you've set one. Flag any that still look off.

On the Knowledge Base tab, you can now click 'Unlock with team phrase' (the same phrase as Team & RACI) instead of a magic-link email — it opens the reader AND the ✍️ New doc composer. Unlocking it on either tab carries over to the other. Confirm it works for whoever you want curating the KB.

Open a card's 📝 Update popup: it shows ALL updates (header now reads 'Updates (N)'), and every entry has ✏️ Edit / 🗑 Delete (works with the team phrase too). If you were only seeing one update on the card FACE, that's the by-design summary — the full list is in the popup.
Review and merge public Knowledge Base PR #15 (Veterans plans) when you have a moment — it's waiting on your sign-off.
One-time: add the Fact Sheet URL (or …/cpl-project-tracker/**) to the Supabase Auth → Redirect URLs list so a magic-link sign-in from the Fact Sheet lands back on that page.
Continue the unverified-M-ID renumber re-mint per the scope doc — staging-cleanup pass, dry-run first, alias map committed.
Build the TMC Phase-2 acceptance engine (the CO-review scoring that decides whether a college's submitted courses meet each ADT's requirements).
Stand up the CPL-Assistant CCR/CER recommender ETL so the assistant can suggest the right course/credential a college could adopt.
